title: What the Wayfare Rentals Weekly Rate Includes, and Tolls
content:
The weekly rate of a Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals) vehicle carries the services below. The coverage is the same for every class, except charging at Wayfare hub chargers, which depends on the class.

## Included with every class

| Service | Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan, Hybrid Sedan, Electric Sedan, Midsize SUV, Minivan and Premium Sedan |
|---|---|
| Routine maintenance and repairs from wear | Included and never charged |
| Insurance coverage included in the weekly rate | State minimum liability and collision, with a deductible |
| 24-hour roadside assistance | Included |

## Charging at Wayfare hub chargers

| Vehicle class | Charging at Wayfare hub chargers included at no cost |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan | No |
| Wayfare Rentals Hybrid Sedan | No |
| Wayfare Rentals Electric Sedan | Yes |
| Wayfare Rentals Midsize SUV | No |
| Wayfare Rentals Minivan | No |
| Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan | No |

## Tolls

Tolls on a rental vehicle are charged at the posted toll with no administration fee, and the toll amounts follow the per-facility amounts Wayfare charges riders under Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares).

## Questions on coverage

**Is a routine service visit charged to the renter?** No. Routine maintenance and repairs from wear are included for every class and never charged.

**Is hub charging free for a Wayfare Rentals Hybrid Sedan?** No. Charging at Wayfare hub chargers is included at no cost only for the Wayfare Rentals Electric Sedan.

**Is a fee added on top of a toll?** No. A toll is passed through at the posted amount with no administration fee.
